title: 3 bridges in Cagayan town remain flooded due to shear line rains

blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY — Three overflow bridges in Baggao, Cagayan remained closed to motorists on Monday after rains brought by the shear line caused the Cagayan River and its tributaries to swell. The Baggao Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office reported that the Bagunot, Mosimoc, and Taytay-San Isidro overflow bridges were impassable due to flooding.
